blocks.html: Southern Metro Manila has that laidback vibe that makes it synonymous to relaxation and recreation. This same reason has always made the south a favorite living destination for those who wish to experience the utmost in quality urban living.

Now combine this with the convenience of being steps away from a lifestyle mall and you've got the ideal place to live in, especially nowadays when residing close to life's essentials has become a necessity.

This is the lifestyle Robinsons Land Corporation and DMCI Homes aim to offer in Sonora Garden Residences, a 1.45-hectare pre-selling condominium development within Robinsons Place Las Piñas complex in Alabang-Zapote Road, Las Piñas City.

With the enviable perks of resort-living plus the ease of being close to retail and dining destinations, supermarkets, business centers, airports, universities, and health institutions, the joint venture development presents a home that is attuned to a convenient and comfortable new normal lifestyle.
The property is ideal for young professionals and startup families as its three buildings—Cadence, Liran, and Stellan—feature big unit cuts spanning 28 to 81.5 square meters (sqm) with balcony.

Other than being spacious, the living spaces also have adequate supply of fresh air and natural light to offer healthy living spaces for the whole family by virtue of DMCI Homes’ Lumiventt® Technology healthy building design.
This design innovation not only reduces electricity usage but also brings positive health benefits by virtue of cross-ventilation and natural illumination.
Furthermore, the amenities and design of the whole development were carefully planned to meet the requisites of an evolving lifestyle.

At Sonora Garden Residences, residents will have plenty of space to relish the relaxing vibe in the south as 70 percent of the property's land area is devoted to open spaces, lush gardens, and various resort-inspired amenities ideal for family and community activities.
Residents can also relax at the lap pool and leisure pool; enjoy a workout at the fitness gym; or play hoops at the basketball court.
An awesome treat likewise awaits at the Sky Lounge of the Cadence and Liran buildings where one can have an unobstructed view of the metro skyline while enjoying a meal at the snack bar.
The property also has a jogging path, pool deck, open lounge, entertainment room and many other amenities that satisfy every whim.
Moreover, Sonora Garden Residences features amenities that cater to kids such as children’s play area, kiddie pool, and open lawn, making the property and ideal home for the whole family.

Meanwhile, the condominium has facilities like high-speed elevators, card-operated laundry system, convenience store, and water station to make living in the property convenient and trouble-free for the whole family.
In addition, Sonora Garden Residences will have its own team of property management professionals who will ensure the upkeep, safety, and security of the property.
Experience all these pleasures of modern living in an excellent urbanized city in the south when you invest in Sonora Garden Residences. Units are now pre-selling at P 4 million onwards.

Sonora Garden Residences is a joint venture of DMCI Homes and Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC). To learn more about the project, call DMCI Homes at (632) 5324-8888/0917 880 8800 or reach RLC Residences through email at asksales@rlcresidences.com and mobile no. 0925 800 0000.
